description: This file defines parameter classes and related types for FastAPI, including classes for query, header, path, cookie, body, form, and file parameters, as well as dependency and security classes.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enum defining parameter locations such as query, header, path, and cookie.

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Class representing a generic parameter with various validation and serialization options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Subclass of Param, specifically for path parameters; enforces no default value.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Subclass of Param, specifically for query parameters.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Subclass of Param, specifically for header parameters, with underscore conversion.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Subclass of Param, specifically for cookie parameters.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Class representing request body parameters with media type and embedding options.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Subclass of Body for form-encoded data.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Subclass of Form for file uploads with multipart/form-data media type.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Dataclass representing a dependency to be injected into path operation functions.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Subclass of Depends, adding security scopes for security dependencies.
